title: Cinema Memory
description: A woman in a silver jacket sits alone in a vintage red-velvet movie theater, smoking a cigarette with eyes closed. Behind her, a large screen projects a colorful silhouette of a motorcycle rider against palm trees, while film strips, framed pictures, and flowers decorate the surrounding walls.
prompt: A lone woman with dark hair wearing a shiny silver jacket sits in an old red velvet cinema seat, holding a lit cigarette to her lips with smoke rising, eyes closed in contemplation. Behind her a large movie screen shows a vibrant pink, orange and teal silhouette of a person riding a motorcycle through palm trees. The theater walls have ornate framed pictures, scattered film reels and strips on the floor, white flowers growing around the frames, dramatic cinematic lighting with the projector beam visible, moody and atmospheric digital painting.
